items.difficulty_reason: 12 行、不变量张量多项式环的行为：取 R^G 上多项式代数 E → A 的满射；E 是自由 R^G-模，故 (E⊗R)^G = E；记 J = Ker，张量右正合给 A⊗R = (E⊗R)/(J)，于是本引理是 invariants-modulo-bis 引理的特例，直接给出首一多项式 P（像为 (T-b)^n）与恒等式 (T-a)^n = T^n。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-functor-invariants-tensor (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 32634-32644

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the presentation of A as a quotient of a polynomial algebra E over R^G, the identification of the invariants of E tensor R with E by freeness, the right-exactness description of A tensor R as the quotient by the ideal generated by J, and the reduction to the invariants-modulo-bis lemma (source lines 32646-32653)
